name: Schedule
description: Create and manage recurring or one-shot agent schedules.

function.name: schedule
function.description:
Manage scheduled agent jobs (interval, cron, or one-shot).

Actions:
- create — schedule a new job (requires schedule + message)
- list — list jobs (include_disabled to see paused/completed)
- update — change name/message/schedule/repeat on an existing job
- pause / resume — stop or restart a job
- remove — delete a job
- run — fire immediately (outside the normal tick)
- runs — recent run history for a job

Schedule forms:
- Duration one-shot: '30m', '2h', '1d'
- Interval: 'every 30m', 'every 2h'
- Cron (5-field): '0 9 * * *' (daily 09:00)
- ISO one-shot: '2026-06-01T09:00:00'

Jobs run in a fresh scheduler session with no chat context — the message must be self-contained. Default agent_id is the calling agent. Cron-run sessions should not recursively schedule more jobs unless the user explicitly asks.

action.description: Operation to perform. create requires schedule + message.

schedule_id.description: Job id or unique name. Required for update/pause/resume/remove/run/runs.

schedule.description: When to run. Examples: 'every 1h', '30m', '0 9 * * *', '2026-06-01T09:00:00'. Required for create.

message.description: Self-contained prompt delivered to the agent when the job fires. Required for create.

agent_id.description: Target agent id. Defaults to the calling agent.

repeat.description: Optional max run count. Omit for forever (recurring) or once (one-shot). 0/negative = forever.

include_disabled.description: For list: include paused/disabled/completed jobs. Default false.
